metadata.title: Santa Clarita Valley community boundaries
metadata.description: Community boundaries for SCVHistory.com. properties.slug matches the Craft category slug in the neighborhood group. properties.method records where each shape came from: "csa" for a Los Angeles County Countywide Statistical Area, "zcta" for a Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area.
caveats: The City of Santa Clarita publishes no community or planning-area layer on ArcGIS Online or ArcGIS Hub, so Newhall, Saugus, Valencia and Canyon Country are approximated from Census ZCTAs rather than taken from a city source.

Those four previously used LA County CSA polygons, which cover only the unincorporated remnant of each community. The ZCTA shapes are 8 to 31 times larger and are the better approximation, but they are still approximations.
Canyon Country and Valencia each combine two ZCTAs kept as separate rings, not dissolved, so an internal seam is visible where they meet.
san-francisquito-canyon uses the combined "San Francisquito Canyon/Bouquet Canyon" CSA, which overlaps the separate bouquet-canyon polygon.

Checked against the county shapes: Stevenson Ranch ZCTA 91381 is within 10 percent of its CSA, which supports the method. Castaic ZCTA 91384 is about a third of its CSA, because the county area sweeps in a large amount of undeveloped backcountry. Both keep their CSA polygon.
metadata.neighbors_method: properties.neighbors is derived from these simplified polygons: two communities are listed as neighbours when any boundary vertex of one lies within 250 m of a boundary segment of the other. It is a proximity test on generalised geometry, not a topological adjacency computation, so it can miss a narrow touch or include a near miss. Recomputed after the four ZCTA shapes replaced their CSA fragments, so it now reflects the wider community outlines.

properties.name: Canyon Country
properties.note: Approximated from the 91351 and 91387 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas. ZCTAs follow census blocks, not postal routes or community lines, and reach into undeveloped land, so this is wider than the community as residents describe it. The two ZCTAs are kept as separate rings rather than dissolved into one outline, so a seam shows where they meet.

properties.name: Newhall
properties.note: Approximated from the 91321 ZIP Code Tabulation Area. ZCTAs follow census blocks, not postal routes or community lines, and reach into undeveloped land, so this is wider than the community as residents describe it.

properties.name: San Francisquito Canyon
properties.note: Source polygon is the combined CSA "San Francisquito Canyon/Bouquet Canyon". It also covers Bouquet Canyon, which has its own separate CSA polygon in this file.

properties.name: Santa Clarita
properties.note: City of Santa Clarita boundary. Incorporated 1987; it contains Newhall, Saugus, Valencia and Canyon Country, which are mapped separately from ZIP Code Tabulation Areas.
